items.title: Israel and Lebanon agree to implement ceasefire if Hezbollah stops attacks
items.description: The countries reject "any attempt, by any state or non-state actor, to hold Lebanon's future hostage", the US says.

items.title: US House delivers rebuke to Trump as it votes to halt Iran war
items.description: In the 215-208 vote, four Republicans joined Democrats to pass the measure, which is largely symbolic.

items.title: 'Crazy' phone call between Trump and Netanyahu complicates Iran talks
items.description: Israel's PM laughed off reports of friction, but he has tested the patience of other US presidents.

items.title: Grab what you can while you can: The new reality in the South China Sea
items.description: After years of watching China create land to back its expansive claims, others are doing the same.

items.title: Missing Sherpa guide found on Mount Everest after 'miracle' self-rescue
items.description: Cleaners found Dawa Sherpa crawling towards Base Camp six days after he went missing at a higher altitude.

items.title: Ukraine accused of killing four in occupied Crimea
items.description: At least 10 people have been injured in the attacks, according to Russian-backed officials.

items.title: Heavy gunfire in Somali capital as row over election delay escalates
items.description: The opposition has called for protests after the president's term in office was extended by a year.

items.title: Trump to nominate Blanche for attorney general on permanent basis
items.description: If confirmed by the Senate, Trump's former personal lawyer would become the administration's number one prosecutor.

items.title: Indian film union drops boycott call against Bollywood star Ranveer Singh
items.description: The producers of Don 3 had earlier complained that Singh's alleged exit from the film had caused major financial losses.

items.title: Germany blames Russia for 'bitter defeat' in UN Security Council bid
items.description: Johann Wadephul said it was "no secret" Russia had stirred up sentiment against Germany over its support for Ukraine.

items.title: China bans four New Zealand MPs over Taiwan visit
items.description: Upon their return from Taiwan last month, the lawmakers were told that China had banned them for a year.

items.title: Senate Republicans axe $1bn for Trump's new White House ballroom
items.description:
The bill to fund immigration agencies has been delayed by opposition to Trump's 
'anti-weaponisation fund'.
